note: 01:48 UTC: t6 (dunes and rock, dropped as a look), the lab's silk study. Next: soft light, the flow's new rates.

looks.label: 3150, variant t6 in the second tree (not committed), draft, one sample: silk and cumulus by the new height law. It reads as dunes and dark rock, not as cloud. Line (i) 22.572. Dropped as a look; its laws are kept for the next variant with soft light.
Lab sheet, not the film's shader: billow noise as a height field, lit from the film's side. A form study for the silk between the tops.

State s, frame 3150 at one sample, lens 64 (left) and 50 (right), same eye point and aim. Lines on the ground fit a pinhole within 2.5 and 2.9 px rms of a 1920 frame; the lens is not a fisheye. Lens 40 is drawing

Design aid, not the film: four height laws drawn by a small offline tool against the same Sun (33.3 degrees, ahead left). Upper left is state s (pimples on a plain), upper right is t5 (reads as rock). Neither is cloud yet
